title: use_figma must be preceded by figma-use skill load
prompt: Add a 1920x1080 frame with a centered 'Hello world' text node to the canvas.
success_criteria: The figma-use skill is loaded BEFORE the first use_figma call.
The use_figma call returns the created node IDs (createdNodeIds[]) per the skill rule.
Color values are in the 0-1 range (not 0-255), per figma-use Critical Rule #6.
Font is loaded via figma.loadFontAsync before the text node is created.
Total use_figma calls <= 2 (one for the frame + text in a single batch is preferred).

deterministic_validators.description: figma-use skill is loaded before the first use_figma call.
A Figma write call was made.
The Figma write returned created node IDs.

notes: Tests that the mandatory skill-loading discipline holds even on trivial tasks.
